description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAttachmentModel' defines a data model for employee attachment information within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits for serialization and implements an interface for normalization, encapsulating properties like id, description, filename, size, fileType, attachedBy, attachedByName, attachedTime, and attachedDate. The class is part of the API layer for handling employee attachment data.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class representing employee attachment data for API responses, implementing normalization and serialization behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PartialEmployeeAttachment entity and sets up filtering and attribute mapping for serialization.
